source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), once this model has shot, pick 1 enemy unit hit by at least 1 of those attacks. For the rest of the turn, each melee attack made by a friendly **TYRANIDS** unit against that enemy unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

This ability can affect a given enemy unit only once per turn.
